info.description: Source: [https://developer.sabre.com/content-services-for-lodging](https://developer.sabre.com/content-services-for-lodging) \[Last updated - August, 2026\] \*NOTE: examples responses are limited to 5 results to keep the Postman collection reduced in size. ### Summary The _Content Services for Lodging_ product collection contains our set of lodging APIs meant to streamline and enhance your booking tool. [Read more about Content Services for Lodging (CSL)](https://developer.sabre.com/content-services-for-lodging/about) ### Workflows ### Content Services for Lodging APIs (REST) - [Get Hotel Avail](https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/get-hotel-avail/v5.0/index.html)**:** Provides lead rate for multiple properties based on search criteria. - [Get Hotel Details](https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/get-hotel-details/v5.1/index.html)**:** Provides detailed information on individual rates available at a specific property. - [Hotel Price Check](https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/hotel-price-check/v5/index.html)**:** Provides confirmation that the rate is still available at the same price, and includes the booking key required for a reservation. - [Booking Management:](https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/booking-management-api/v1/index.html) - [Create Booking](https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/booking-management-api/v1/_attachments/spec.yml#createBooking_post)**:** Reserves one or more hotel rooms and creates a lodging segment and creates a new PNR. - [Get Booking](https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/booking-management-api/v1/_attachments/spec.yml#getBooking_post)**:** Provides all information about a booking, including the Sabre PNR, supplier confirmation number, and other booking details. - [Modify Booking](https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/booking-management-api/v1/_attachments/spec.yml#modifyBooking_post)**:** Modify Booking provides a single, unified service to modify a booking for different content sources. - [Cancel Booking](https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/booking-management-api/v1/_attachments/spec.yml#cancelBooking_post)**:** Cancel Booking provides a single, unified service to cancel the entire reservation, or a part of the reservation, irrespective of what it contains (flight, hotel, car, others) and where it is created (NDC, Sabre, CSL, LCC).

[//]: # "Start" [Description](https://developer.sabre.com/docs/rest_apis/session_management/token_create_api/v2), [Resources](https://developer.sabre.com/docs/rest_apis/session_management/token_create_api/v2/reference-documentation), [Password Management](https://developer.sabre.com/guides/travel-agency/developer-guides/password-management), [Client IDs](https://developer.sabre.com/guides/travel-agency/developer-guides/sabre-api-client-ids) - OAuth Token Create /v2 is the standard method for authentication & authorization of **Stateless Sabre REST APIs**. - /v2 requires the standard authentication parameters: username, password, organization & domain - OAuth Token Create /v3 has been enhanced to provide better logging/tracking by requiring 2 additional parameters: clientId + clientSecret. - Be mindful of these differences when choosing which version to use.

*note:* The below example depicts a **/v2** request where only the 4 standard security attributes are required.
If you have successfully imported the environment file associated with this collection, you will have the following variables available for you to add your credentials: _{{username}}_, _{{password}}_, _{{pcc}}_, _{{client_id}}_ & _{{client_secret}}_.

The general script logic in this collection will take the values you define in these variables, encode them following the encryption guidelines defined [here](https://developer.sabre.com/guides/travel-agency/developer-guides/rest-apis-token-credentials) and will use them in the execution of this service.
Upon successfull execution, the corresponding token will be stored in a _{{token}}_ variable and will be automatically used in subsequent API calls. With the goal of making your life easier :) [//]: # "End"

item.description:
# Authentication

Start with "Get a Token":

[https://developer.sabre.com/guides/travel-agency/quickstart-guides/get-token](https://developer.sabre.com/guides/travel-agency/quickstart-guides/get-token)

### OAuth Token Create REST API (/v3/auth/token)

[https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/oauth-token-create-rest-api/v3](https://developer.sabre.com/rest-api/oauth-token-create-rest-api/v3)

This API is a utility service exposing an authentication endpoint which generates an ATK **access token**, which enables access to other Sabre APIs. It follows the OAuth2 specification to delegate access to Sabre’s resources.EndFragment

item.description:
#### Add fields in existing CSL segments

Fields could be added to the existing segment if they were not provided during the original sell request. Add one or more of the following fields to the existing CSL segment:

- Special Instructions
    
- Loyalty ID
    
- Frequent Traveler number
    
- Corporate ID number
    
- Form of Payment
    
- Arrival/Departure time
    

#### Modify fields in existing CSL segments

Change the value of an existing field in the PNR segment by modifying one of the following fields:

- Room Type\*
    
- Check In/Check Out date outside date range\*
    
- Guest Number\*
    
- Check In/Check Out date within a date range
    
- Guest Loyalty ID
    
- Corporate ID number
    
- Frequent Traveler Number
    
- Arrival Time/Departure Time
    
- Special Instructions
    
- Form of Payment
    
- IATA number
    
- Lead Guest Name

request.description:
# Overview

The Alternate Properties API aims to improve the agent and developer user experience when searching for lodging availability by providing useful information on relevant alternate properties, reducing the need to conduct additional searches, and improving efficiency.

The API will be beneficial to agencies and booking tools that:

- Use GetHotelDetails or GetHotelRateInfo without conducting a prior market availability search
- Are focused on providing relevant properties in shopping response
- Want to increase efficiency when shopping/booking lodging content
    

# How to use

Based on the pattern hotel ID in a request, similar hotels from the same city return in a response. The API is used to find similar properties in Content Services for Lodging.

For example, finding other similar properties when the initially requested property is unavailable, and alternates are needed can be useful.

Use the Alternate Global hotel IDs in the response with other Content Services for Lodging APIs to get content (images, descriptive data) and rates (shopping) for the suggested alternative properties. Additional parameters like distance, direction, and amenities give the customer the possibility of a better choice.

# Usage

Refer to the complete Lodging AI Alternate Properties API documentation on [Dev Studio](https://developer.sabre.com/docs/rest_apis/travel_ai/lodging_ai/alternate_properties)

The API provides information about the polygon available in the SABRE Geo database, based on multiple criteria such as polygon ID, area, city, state or country code. The search results can be filtered based on a date range by providing the start date and end date (both inclusive) in the request. The response will contain the details of all the polygons created/updated within this date range.

item.description: Source: [https://developer.sabre.com/content-services-for-lodging](https://developer.sabre.com/content-services-for-lodging) \[Last updated - August, 2025\] \*NOTE: examples responses are limited to 5 results to keep the Postman collection reduced in size. ### Summary The _Content Services for Lodging_ product collection contains our set of lodging APIs meant to streamline and enhance your booking tool. [Read more about Content Services for Lodging (CSL)](https://developer.sabre.com/content-services-for-lodging/about) ### Workflows ### Content Services for Lodging APIs (REST) - [Get Hotel Avail](https://developer.sabre.com/docs/rest_apis/hotel/search/get_hotel_avail)**:** Provides lead rate for multiple properties based on search criteria. - [Get Hotel Details](https://developer.sabre.com/docs/rest_apis/hotel/search/get_hotel_details)**:** Provides detailed information on individual rates available at a specific property. - [Hotel Price Check](https://developer.sabre.com/docs/rest_apis/hotel/search/hotel_price_check)**:** Provides confirmation that the rate is still available at the same price, and includes the booking key required for a reservation. - [Booking Management:](https://developer.sabre.com/docs/rest_apis/trip/orders/booking_management) - [Create Booking](https://developer.sabre.com/docs/rest_apis/trip/orders/booking_management/reference-documentation#createBooking_post)**:** Reserves one or more hotel rooms and creates a lodging segment and creates a new PNR. - [Get Booking](https://developer.sabre.com/docs/rest_apis/trip/orders/booking_management/reference-documentation#getBooking_post)**:** Provides all information about a booking, including the Sabre PNR, supplier confirmation number, and other booking details.
